summary: Bova Mountain tower in Cattaraugus County was one of five towers in operation in Allegany State Park by the end of 1928; the Forest Fire Lookout Association county list marks it gone. No build or removal date found.

notes_for_editor: Only one historical mention was found, a 1928 sentence in the Summit Fire Tower Wikipedia article; the sentence's own source was not read. The Forest Lookouts page for Bova is a title and county only. No build date, staffing, removal date, or site description appears in any source read, so the story says nothing about them. The Forest Fire Lookout Association county list marks the tower gone, consistent with the brief. Unchecked lead: the NYSFFLA Southern Tier list (http://www.nysffla.org/towers8.htm, cited in the Alma Hill research) may cover Bova Mountain; it was not read because the page-read budget was spent. Two search calls were used.
